verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a robust export feature (text, HTML, OPML, PNG, EDN, JSON, Markdown, and Roam-compatible export) plus underlying local markdown/org files, which nominally supports easy exit in open formats. But hands-on community reports concretely contradict the 'easy to leave' claim: exported Markdown adds non-standard formatting incompatible with other apps like Obsidian, and the newer DB-based version reportedly no longer keeps data as plain markdown files, undermining portability for switchers. missing for 10: independent confirmation that exports are truly interchangeable with other tools, and resolution of the DB-format lock-in concern.
